findings.finding: The adapter used /public/token/<address> and /public/pool/<address> with Bearer authentication instead of current documented Solana query-address endpoints and X-API-KEY.
findings.evidence: Current original native source and official protocol documentation. Isolated request assertions exercise actual adapter calls.
findings.qualification: No credentialed API request was made; operator subscription/access and the cause or number of missed real trades are not established.
findings.remediation: Use documented token overview and pair overview endpoints, explicit Solana header, address query and disabled redirects.
findings.confidence: High for native software reproduction; real-provider and economic impact unestablished.

findings.finding: A current scalar liquidity response raised AttributeError in native normalization; current volume and 5m activity were not projected reliably into entry collection.
findings.evidence: Actual native original-C reproduction throws on scalar liquidity, and original entry snapshot fails to supply requested activity.
findings.remediation: Typed scalar/nested normalization, nullable malformed optional fields, valid finite market numbers and original receipt-bound native entry integration.
findings.confidence: High for native software reproduction; real-provider and economic impact unestablished.

findings.finding: Original adapter accepted false/absent success or wrong/missing provider identity and relabelled data with the requested mint.
findings.evidence: Native original-C success-envelope and identity regressions fail.
findings.remediation: Require success is exactly true, object payload, exact case-sensitive requested public key and no conflicting declared network before stamping/caching. Validate pair base identity separately.
findings.confidence: High for native software reproduction; real-provider and economic impact unestablished.

findings.finding: Undocumented overview birth aliases or ages could enter canonical birth predictors; mint creation and venue creation were not independently requested.
findings.evidence: Native original-C isolated legacy-shaped overview alias tests reproduce canonical birth/age promotion. Separate creation API was absent.
findings.remediation: Detach overview clocks/ages as untyped diagnostics; preserve pair creation only at venue grain; provide an explicit cached creation lookup with original token, timestamp, signature and slot shape checks.
findings.qualification: Creation receipt is provider-reported, not independent chain verification. Automatic birth enrichment and creator/chain provenance are not implemented by this stage.
findings.confidence: High for native software reproduction; real-provider and economic impact unestablished.

implemented: Documented token/pair request and authentication contract, strict success/object/identity/network handling and no redirects carrying credentials.

Strict 32-byte Base58 shape independent of optional base58 dependency. Valid raw pump-ending identities remain unchanged; only invalid token inputs may use a valid controlled suffix repair. Pool identities never receive token suffix cleanup.

Current price, scalar liquidity, USD volume, market cap, holder and 5m trade/buy/sell/price/volume fields normalized with genuine zero and nullable absence. Signed/extreme percentage fields are not clipped.

Contract-versioned detached positive/negative caches retain original HTTP receipts. Refresh still applies the cooperative global throttle; cancellation propagates without a fabricated negative result. Logged exceptions expose their type only.
Current pair overview keeps requested pair identity and documented base mint separate; creation remains a nullable venue event, not canonical birth.

Explicit get_token_creation_info uses the documented independent mint-creation endpoint, 24h context cache and validated seconds/slot/signature/token context. No ordinary price or entry request automatically adds a creation call or provider CU cost.

76 native new cases plus adjusted existing freshness fixture; the existing native get_entry_snapshot consumer supplies current extreme activity from one successful overview without an extra fallback request.

preflight_reporting_retry.reason: PowerShell reporting wrapper used true instead of $true; corrected complete reruns confirm exit0/ok in each root. This was a reporting command error, not a source or pytest failure.

remaining_boundaries: No operator Birdeye authentication, subscription entitlement, quota/RPM/CU acceptance, production latency or provider market-as-of/depth acceptance is tested. The configurable local throttle is not a guarantee of a provider tier allowance.

Automatic creation enrichment in the actual scanner/queue and independent chain/creator verification remain separate. This explicit adapter must not be described as authenticated original birth or activated automatic enrichment.
Price/cash extremes are software scenarios; actual profitable capture, rare-event generalization, full-strategy financial risk, live wallet/finality and prospective net returns are unestablished.
Legacy age-based training cohort selection, other provider contracts/access, complete first-launch operational acceptance and full-strategy generation/provenance remain independent and incomplete.
completion_rule: This bounded provider software repair does not establish a winning bot, exhaustive opportunity coverage, real data access, guaranteed future returns or zero future errors.
